page.about.paragraph: I am a Senior Software Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with 8 years of experience in software development, specializing in both front-end and back-end technologies. I have strong expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and SQL, along with frameworks like Angular and ReactJS. I also work with libraries such as Bootstrap 5, Angular Material, and Tailwind to create responsive, user-friendly interfaces. Dedicated to delivering high-quality software solutions, I focus on enhancing user experiences and driving business success through innovation and technical excellence.
page.about.brief: Hello, I'm Amer! I'm a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in software development. I specialize in building scalable, user-friendly applications using the latest web technologies. Feel free to reach out for collaboration, project inquiries, or tech discussions!
